verdict.rationale: dLocal's own docs reference a Checkout Redirect option that offers a "ready-to-use design and front end," so merchants can avoid building their own payment UI. Payment Links are a related hosted option that "requires no integration." The evidence is a single brief mention, though, with no detail on the redirect flow, its parameters, or any conversion optimization. Missing for 10: documentation of the Checkout Redirect flow and parameters, evidence of conversion-optimized design, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: you can process payments safely and simply with a ready-to-use design and front end. Learn more about Checkout Redirect.
Payment links allow you to collect payments securely and go to market in no time... it requires no integration.
